description: This file defines a class Net_Socket for socket communication, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, reading, writing, configuring socket options, and handling socket status. It extends PEAR and provides a generalized interface for socket operations.

classes.name: Net_Socket
classes.description: A class providing socket communication functionalities, supporting connection management, data transmission, configuration, and status monitoring.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a given address and port, optionally persistent and with specified timeout and options.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the existing socket connection.

methods.name: isBlocking
methods.description: Returns whether the socket is in blocking mode.

methods.name: setBlocking
methods.description: Sets the socket's blocking mode.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout value for socket operations.

methods.name: setWriteBuffer
methods.description: Sets the write buffer size for the socket stream.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns status information about the socket.

methods.name: gets
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data from the socket.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the socket.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket, with optional block size control.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of data followed by CRLF to the socket.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the socket has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: readByte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the socket.

methods.name: readWord
methods.description: Reads two bytes (a word) from the socket.

methods.name: readInt
methods.description: Reads four bytes (an integer) from the socket.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from the socket.

methods.name: readIPAddress
methods.description: Reads four bytes and formats as an IPv4 address string.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line of data from the socket, up to a newline.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Reads all data until the socket closes.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Performs a select call on the socket with a timeout, checking readability, writability, or errors.

methods.name: enableCrypto
methods.description: Enables or disables encryption on the socket, requires PHP >= 5.1.0.
